extDescription.message: Download Bluesky videos and GIFs with down.blue, from the toolbar, the right-click menu, and a button on every video post.

optFooterAllPosts.message: Show the button on every post, not only on posts with a video

optPrivacyNote.message: Permissions requested: Context menus to add right-click options. Active tab to read the post URL when you click the extension. Storage for your settings. Scripting to add the button to the sites you add here. Nothing is collected.
